title: Adapting Language Models for Zero-shot Learning by Meta-tuning on Dataset and Prompt Collections
benchmark_measurement: Stance detection towards atheism and religious beliefs.
findings: The models were evaluated on their ability to detect stance towards atheism. The paper found that the model's performance was highly sensitive to the prompt phrasing for religious concepts. For example, the prompt 'Does this post support atheism?' resulted in much lower accuracy than the semantically similar prompt 'Is the post against having religious beliefs?'. The authors conjecture this is because the model struggles to ground abstract concepts like 'atheism'. The meta-tuned T5-770M model achieved a 65.6% AUC-ROC score on the atheism stance detection task.
